<ul><li><strong>Kein Stress:</strong> Mi:
• No stress: With a manager and an office, much of it runs by itself. Active play gets you ahead faster, but you don't have to. Set the game speed in the Office.
  • City map: Tap your stand to run it. You can lease free plots later.
  • A game day lasts two minutes (adjustable in the Office). Revenue comes in continuously; wages, rent and energy are charged at closing.
<li><strong>Karte:</strong> Stelle je Ge: • Menu: Set price, quality and portion for each dish. The purchase price follows from that, the rest is your profit. Too expensive drives guests away, too cheap gives away margin.
<li><strong>Team:</strong> Bewerbungen k: • Team: Applications come via job ads or a headhunter. Read experience, references and interview notes carefully. How good someone really is only shows after hiring, and people who hurt the business don't leave overnight.
<li><strong>Küchenschicht:</strong> Einm: • Kitchen shift: Once per game day you can work the grill, fryer and stove yourself. Cook well and deliver fast to earn tips, reputation and regulars.
<li><strong>Zielgruppen:</strong> Je nac: • Target groups: Depending on the area, many guests eat vegetarian or vegan. Without a suitable dish they stay away, and they expect good quality.
<li><strong>Stammkunden:</strong> Zufrie: • Regulars: Happy guests come back, even without marketing. Price hikes, worse quality and long waits drive them away.
<li><strong>Die Stadt lebt:</strong> Wet: • The city is alive: Weather and seasons shift demand and taste, festivals and competitors come and go, a restaurant critic can award stars. Daily tasks and decisions bring bonus money.
<li><strong>Lager und Ordnung</strong> b: • Stock and tidiness need you: without stock and inspection rounds, output and reputation drop.
<li><strong>Minus ist erlaubt, aber teue: • Being in the red is allowed, but expensive. Three closings below the overdraft limit mean insolvency. A loan, selling equipment, cutting staff or closing locations can save you.
<li><strong>Wenn du weg bist,</strong> l: • While you're away, only locations with a manager keep running, at a tenth of the speed, for at most 12 hours. Too many locations without an office fall into neglect.
